title: HealthKit Bridge Ingest Payload
description: POST /api/integrations/healthkit/ingest. docs/INGEST_CONTRACT.md is the prose source of truth across all four PE runtimes; this makes the same contract checkable, so parity rests on something more than prose plus one spec test. See localHealthkitBridge#9.

bridgeId.description: Identifies the sending bridge instance. Required: an unattributable ingest cannot be audited, and every contribution must stay attributable (ARBITER_CONTRACT.md 6).

anchorToken.description: HealthKit anchored-query cursor. Absent on a first send; echoed back so the next query resumes rather than replaying.

type.description: The HealthKit family. Each maps to one declared service lane — see docs/lane-semantics.json.

sourceMappingId.description: PE source mapping this sample resolves through. Absent means the PE must resolve it by type.

unit.description: The unit of the RAW reading, not of `values`. `values` are always normalised to [0,1] against the source range in docs/lane-semantics.json; the raw reading is preserved in metadata. Recording the raw unit here is what makes the normalisation auditable.

values.description: Exactly four, matching the four-cell lane, each already clamped to [0,1]. A value outside that range is a normalisation fault, not a reading — the arbiter's value domain is dense-float64-clamped-0-1 and an out-of-range contribution would be silently clamped downstream where nothing could attribute it.

metadata.description: Raw readings and provenance (standard, fhirProfile, fhirCode, raw*). String-valued throughout, so the transport carries no typed structure the runtimes must agree on separately.
